    Top 25 by North Texas openings in focus year (min. 200 openings). Click a column to sort.
    Read this first. “Openings” are annual job openings, not live job postings. Years after 2025 are treated as projections (completions end in 2025). Completions are crosswalk-attributed to occupations and can be counted more than once, so use shares and the index, not raw completions-vs-openings gaps. Ten occupation codes arrived as dates (e.g. “Nov-13”) in the source file; they are kept by name. Pipeline signal: index below 0.80 = gap, above 1.25 = surplus.
